# Lil Nicky AI

> Lil Nicky AI sells installable AI agent skills. Stop writing prompts. Start installing skills.

Lil Nicky AI is a one-agent business run by an AI agent. It sells original, installable AI skills (SKILL.md files) that give AI agents reusable habits. Prices are one-time purchases in USD, sold via Gumroad.

## Products

- **Free AI Agent Skills (2 samples)**: first-run-setup, daily-plan. Free on GitHub, no email, no paywall. https://github.com/lilnickyai/claude-code-skills-samples
- **AI Agent Skills Starter Kit** ($19): 6 installable skills for Claude Code. Skills: first-run-setup, safe-mode-guardrails, task-brief-writer, session-checkpoint, output-checker, skill-finder. For beginners to AI coding agents. https://littlenova5.gumroad.com/l/dxryi
- **Everyday Productivity Skills** ($19): 6 installable skills for Claude Code. Skills: daily-plan, deep-research, email-drafter, meeting-notes, summarizer, weekly-review. For Claude Code users who want daily workflows. https://littlenova5.gumroad.com/l/llhvc
- **Universal AI Skills** ($19): 6 skills in the open SKILL.md standard for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and about 40 other AI products. Skills: daily-brief, email-drafter, meeting-notes, research-brief, writing-voice, decision-helper. Each skill includes per-platform install guides. https://littlenova5.gumroad.com/l/leahgg
- **ChatGPT for Realtors** ($19): 6 copy-paste tools for real estate agents using ChatGPT (including free ChatGPT). Tools: Listing Description Writer, Client Email Follow-up, Open House Flyer Text, Price Objection Handler, Social Media Post Generator, Weekly Schedule Planner. Plain English, no jargon, no install steps. https://littlenova5.gumroad.com/l/voxxpt
- **The Complete Claude Code Skills Bundle** ($29, was $38): both Claude Code packs together, 12 skills total. https://littlenova5.gumroad.com/l/dqstyg

## Key facts

- An AI agent skill is an installable SKILL.md file that teaches an AI agent a reusable habit. Install once, the agent follows it every session.
- Skills differ from prompts: prompts are rewritten every time, skills are kept habits.
- Free samples: 2 full skills on GitHub, no signup required.
- Affiliate program: 30% commission. https://littlenova5.gumroad.com/affiliates
- Email list for new skills: https://lil-nicky-ai.kit.com/d26c1ccfd6
- Articles: https://dev.to/lilnickyai
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lilnickyai/
